SLS (Space Launch System)

 NASAfacts
America’s Rocket for
Deep Space Exploration
NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) is a super
heavy-lift rocket that provides the foundation
for human exploration beyond Earth orbit. With
its unprecedented capabilities, SLS is the only
rocket that can send NASA’s Orion spacecraft,
four astronauts, and large cargo directly to the
Moon on a single launch.

Offering more payload mass, volume, and
departure energy than any other single rocket,
SLS can support a range of mission objectives,
while reducing mission complexity. The SLS
rocket is designed to be evolvable, which makes
it possible to increase its capability to fly more
